title: First Mid Insurance Group Retains Best Practices Agency Recognition for 2026
summary: Mattoon, IL (August 17, 2026) First Mid Insurance Group (FMIG), a leading provider of insurance solutions, is proud to announce it has once again been recognized as a Best Practices Agency for 2026, marking the seventh time it has achieved this honor. This recognition places FMIG among an exclusive group of independent insurance agencies nationwide. The Best Practices Agency designation is awarded to participants in the Best Practices Study, a comprehensive analysis of the business operations and performance of the insurance industry's top-performing independent agencies. More than 1,190 independent insurance agencies across the United States were nominated during this study cycle. For the 2026 study year, only 300 agencies qualified for and maintained their Best Practices Agency designation.
